use_case: Generative AI document extraction in the tax software: reads scanned W-2, 1099, 1098, and K-1 forms and fills return input fields; separate drafting-suggestions feature (proposed treatments and explanations)
vendor_or_model: Tax software vendor feature using an AI sub-processor (generative document understanding model)
data_categories: Scanned source documents with names, SSNs, income, withholding, and bank details (tax return information; GLBA customer information)
consequential_decision_category: None (tax preparation data entry; not a consequential decision category)
human_in_the_loop: Preparer verifies low-confidence, critical, and photographed-document fields; reviewer signs off; e-file only after Form 8879 is signed
status: Extraction in production for all preparers since 2026-01 (about 21,400 returns in 2026); drafting suggestions turned off 2026-08-28 pending counsel

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite for drafting client letters, engagement correspondence, and first drafts of IRS and state notice responses
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor (enterprise generative AI assistant)
data_categories: Prompts with notice text and amounts; client identifiers restricted (no SSNs or account numbers; client names only after counsel confirms the IRC 7216 basis)
human_in_the_loop: A CPA, enrolled agent, or attorney checks every citation and amount and signs every item sent
status: In production for 250 licensed users since 2026-04; conditions due 2026-10-31

use_case: AI tax research assistant: the tax research platform's generative answers with links to primary authorities
vendor_or_model: Tax research platform vendor (generative AI feature over its licensed research content)

human_in_the_loop: Professional confirms every authority in the primary source before use; reviewer signs client memos

use_case: Journal entry analytics for attest engagements: machine learning model scores client general ledger entries for unusual patterns to help auditors select entries for testing
business_owner: Attest Firm Quality and Independence Partner
vendor_or_model: Licensed audit analytics software deployed in the restricted data enclave (vendor-trained anomaly model)

human_in_the_loop: Auditors decide which entries to test and design other procedures; engagement partner reviews; the score never replaces audit judgment

vendor_or_model: Applicant tracking system vendor (resume scoring and ranking model)

human_in_the_loop: Recruiters see all applicants but in 2026 advanced only from the top-ranked third; from 2026-09-15 auto-ranking is suspended for advance decisions
